title: Generate Parentheses
description:
You are given an integer n.

You need to generate all valid combinations of n pairs of parentheses.

What is “valid”?

A parentheses string is valid if:

Every ( has a matching )
At no point do closing brackets exceed opening ones
Task

Return a list of all well-formed parentheses strings of length 2n.

Examples

Example 1

n = 3
→ ["((()))","(()())","(())()","()(())","()()()"]

Example 2

n = 1
→ ["()"]
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 8
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
